maria (eng-runtime): folks — putting together a short plan to add token-level TTFT vs decode attribution that attributes kernel time, kv-cache, queue+batching. want lightweight prod-safe sampling and a dashboard prototype. thoughts?

jin (sre): +1. sampling is key. low overhead. we should avoid tracing every request. 1% sampled traces, with full per-token breakdown only when sampled. basic metrics for all requests.

sandeep (perf): agree. propose three data tiers: (A) full sampled traces (1% prod, 100% canary), (B) aggregated histograms per-route/token-position, (C) lightweight counters for cache hit/miss and kernel buckets.

maria (eng-runtime): sketching metric names: `redwood_token_ttft_ms`, `redwood_token_decode_ms`, `redwood_kernel_ms{kernel}`, `redwood_kv_hit_total`, `redwood_kv_miss_total`, `redwood_batch_wait_ms`. any red flags?

oliver (analytics): good. for histograms -> use exponential buckets up to 2s. export aggregate quantiles p50/p90/p99 for per-route and per-model dashboards. also add tag `route=<route>` and `model=<model>` and `cache_state={cold,warm}`.

sandeep (perf): need to capture kernel attribution beyond a single number. e.g., `kernel_compute_ms`, `kernel_memory_copy_ms`, `kernel_kernel_launch_overhead_ms`. not always possible but we can surface what nvprof/cupti gives for our main kernels.

maria (eng-runtime): sampling plan proposal: 1% random request sampling; additionally capture first N tokens for cold-start requests (kv-cache miss on first token). flagged traces get attached to the probe-bucket and stored for 7d. full traces scrub PII.

jin (sre): must cap full-trace size. store only first 256 tokens in trace payload and aggregated tail. encryption + access control.

probe-bot: sample-capture START ts=1769001241 id=trace-3f2a
probe-bot: metrics_export: redwood_token_ttft_ms{route="/chat",model="rw-7b",cache_state="cold"} 142.3
probe-bot: metrics_export: redwood_kernel_ms{kernel="cutlass_fp16",model="rw-7b"} 98.7
probe-bot: trace-snapshot: token_position=1 kv_hit=false batch_wait_ms=5 decode_ms=24 kernel_ms=99 other_ms=13

oliver (analytics): dashboard UX idea: per-route waterfall stacked by categories [prequeue, batch_wait, kv_lookup, kernel_compute, decode_postproc]. interactive token slider to see how costs evolve across tokens. hover shows p50/p90/p99 and sample trace id.

sandeep (perf): also want a 'kernel chooser debug' heatmap: x=token_pos, y=kernel_variant, cell=avg_kernel_ms. helps find when chooser flips kernels mid-sequence.

maria (eng-runtime): implementation notes: emit Prometheus metrics for aggregated counters/histograms. sampled traces go to our internal trace store (Parquet + S3) with fields flattened. add a lightweight tag `kernel_variant` on every token. instrument Batcher to emit `batch_wait_ms` per token.

jin (sre): rollout: feature-flagged on canary region first. backfill dashboards with 7d of trace-derived aggregates. monitor overhead: target < 2% CPU and < 5% extra network.

maria (eng-runtime): quick config snippet for exporter (proto):
```
metric: "redwood_token_ttft_ms" labels: ["route","model","cache_state"] buckets: exp(start=1, factor=2, count=20)
trace_sample_rate: 0.01
trace_max_tokens: 256
trace_retention_days: 7
```

oliver (analytics): can we also surface a per-route "regression delta" chart: baseline (last 7d) vs current for token p99 of kernel_ms? will help catch perf regressions quickly.

sandeep (perf): yes — hook into alerting: if p99 kernel_ms increases > 15% vs baseline for 3h -> create perf alert.

maria (eng-runtime): open action items: 1) eng-runtime: add kernel tags + batch_wait metric (sandeep + maria) 2) telemetry: implement histogram buckets + exporter (oliver) 3) infra/sre: probe-bot sampling pipeline + retention (jin) 4) analytics: dashboard mock (oliver) 5) security: PII scrub + access controls (jin) — update watchers and I'll spin up a canary flag.

jin (sre): leaving note: rate-limited storage path for traces — if storage backpressure hit, drop non-critical sampled traces and escalate.

maria (eng-runtime): thanks. i'll create a short RFC with the data model and perf budget numbers. attaching an example event payload we can store:
```
{
  "trace_id": "trace-3f2a",
  "route": "/chat",
  "model": "rw-7b",
  "tokens": [
    {"pos":1, "ttft_ms":142.3, "decode_ms":24, "kernel_ms":99, "kernel_variant":"cutlass_fp16", "kv_hit":false},
    {"pos":2, "ttft_ms":31.4, "decode_ms":9, "kernel_ms":18, "kernel_variant":"cutlass_fp16", "kv_hit":true}
  ]
}
```

sandeep (perf): LGTM. let's aim for canary next week. i'll prepare a microbenchmark to validate kernel attribution accuracy.

maria (eng-runtime): great — I'll post the RFC + tracking issue later today. thanks all :thumbsup:
